hierarchy.label: Admin
hierarchy.description: System owner. Configures features, roles, receipt archive, branding. Never touches day-to-day event ops.

hierarchy.label: Management Committee
hierarchy.description: Elected committee. Approves budgets, verifies payments, publishes receipts.

hierarchy.label: Sub-Committee
hierarchy.description: Cultural / Sports / Volunteer sub-committees. Creates events under their cluster, tracks contributions.

hierarchy.label: Society Manager
hierarchy.description: On-site manager. Records offline (cash / cheque) payments, generates duplicate receipts, prints reports.

hierarchy.label: Resident
hierarchy.description: Contributes, registers for events, downloads own receipts, sees permitted public boards.
